description: LCA as Code is a language and command-line tool for defining parametric, reusable life-cycle assessment models. The README gives a sample electricity-mix process and shows impact results as tables, CSV or JSON. Users specify processes, products, inputs and impact indicators; the tool calculates results from those definitions. Geographic coverage depends on inventory inputs and factors chosen by the modeller. The project uses either AGPL-3.0 or a commercial licence according to its licence text. Its README links Cloud Assess as a service that uses the language. A limitation is that a model's output is only as sound as its process boundaries and input factors; the language does not provide a verified universal inventory database. It can encode alternative component or energy-supply assumptions for infrastructure life-cycle simulations. The related Brightway catalogue platform is another LCA environment, not a covering record for this language. No model package or inventory data were downloaded.
name: LCA as Code modelling language
